title: Chihaya Castle current earthwork collection

terrainContact.basis: Original native-context extent midpoint selected before independent full field or any model/floor/mainsection geometry. GSI ground elevations are factual source data, not measured archaeological construction phases or a surveyed host-terrain tie.

notes: Approximate present surviving Chihaya Castle earthwork ensemble: four principal enclosure grounds, southeastern enclosure, southwestern terrace, two current Chaya-no-dan outwork steps and narrow main-bailey northwest/west/south banks. Original current terrain shape and slope breaks retained. All nine bounded ground perimeters except the native lower-context ring are explicit authoring estimates; no archaeological survey, exact medieval edge/date or original grade is asserted. This is current ground form, not a restored medieval castle. Modern shrine/office/pavilion/Zondokan buildings, steles/signs/trees and undetectable lost ditch reconstructions are separate context; the whole natural hill is review terrain, not a castle solid. Collection and all members retain the identical original field/frame/datum; all instance transforms are identity, without new pose or height fitting.
